history: Specified after the V2 study completed and before generating or evaluating the V3 pool. Adds MaskableTRPO (condition T) as a third algorithm alongside the frozen V2 PPO conditions. The V2 final pool is spent and is not reused; this is a fresh pool on a disjoint seed interval. Not preregistered before training.
filter: unchanged experiments.pools.validate_base: structure plus best-of-four-side heuristic destruction in [0.25,0.85]
baseline: HeuristicCommander() once per accepted layout/view; observed-coverage side, not best-side oracle
action_seed_rule: first four bytes of SHA256(v3-final-ds-v1:{label}:{motif}:{base_seed}:{view}), unsigned big endian; reset Python NumPy Torch once per attack, never across attacks
primary_metric: mean fraction of total building value destroyed
primary_comparison: T minus P across ten matched learner seeds on all accepted layouts
aggregation: Equal views and action repeats within each layout; equal accepted layouts within scope; equal weight to each learner. Overall is accepted-layout weighted.

intervals.method: percentile bootstrap across paired learner seeds
intervals.scope: conditional on fixed accepted layouts, eight views and three action labels; unadjusted secondary intervals

selection: All approved final checkpoints for every condition; no best checkpoint or learner selection. No tuning after final results.
limitations: TRPO trains without an entropy bonus because SB3's TRPO hard-codes ent_coef=0.0, while both PPO conditions trained at 0.01. The comparison is between the algorithms as configured, not between matched exploration pressure.
TRPO's critic update zeroes gradients on actor parameters, so the shared SiegeFeatures trunk is updated only by the trust-region step; under PPO both losses reach it.
Intervals resample independent learner seeds and are conditional on the fixed layouts, views and action labels. They do not measure uncertainty over every possible custom base.
V2 and V3 use different final layout pools, so V3 numbers are not directly comparable with the published V2 headline figures. Only within-V3 comparisons are controlled.
An individual replay is an illustration, not an aggregate performance estimate.
